To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

an integrated protocol that includes molecular docking and pharmacological mapping was developed for predicting potential inhibitors from traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) for T2DM-related target and establishing compound-target interaction network, and this integrated protocol can provide a deep insight for polypharmacology and drug design.

the Bayesian classifiers based on molecular docking and pharmacomphore mapping could be developed to predict the potential inhibitors for T2DM-related proteins, and the compound-target interaction networks were established, which could be utilized to elucidate the mechanisms of TCM for T2DM.

the compound-target interaction networks of TCM for T2DM can be established by integrating molecular docking and pharmacological mapping, and the network analysis can offer a deep insight to the theory of the TCM formula for combating T2MD.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the action mechanism of TCM for T2DM and provides a useful tool to identify multitarget inhibitors from TCM.

the prediction of the inhibitors of T2DM-related protein targets from TCM, the establishment of compound-target interaction network and the analysis of the pharmacological effects of the predicted inhibitors.
a new method for identifying multitarget inhibitors of T2DM and establishing the compound-target network.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the TCMs for T2DM are polypharmaceutical agents, and the multitarget interaction is one of the most important mechanisms of TCM for T2DM.

the TCM formulas for treating T2DM are not just a mixture of compounds with direct pharmacological activities for T2DM-related target, but a combination of compounds with direct and indirect pharmacological effects, which may be the main reason that the TCM formula is more effective and safer than a single compound.
the Bayesian classifiers by combining molecular docking and pharmacomophore mapping are useful tools for identifying the multitarget inhibitors from TCM.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the Bayesian classifiers developed in this study are reliable and useful for finding the potential inhibitors from the TCMs and establishing the compound-target interaction networks, which can provide a deep insight for the theory of TCM formulas and a useful source for new lead compounds against diseases.

the Bayesian classifiers by combining the prediction from molecular docking and the pharmacophore mapping are reliable for predicting inhibitors from TCM, and the compound-target interaction networks constructed by the inhibitors predicted by the Bayesian classifiers are valuable to reveal the action mechanism of the TCM and provide a good resource to find new lead compound against T2DM.

the integration of molecular docking and the pharmacophore mapping method could be a promising way to establish the compound-target network and find the potential inhibitors of the T2DM targets from the TCM, which may provide useful information for polypharmacology and drug design.

it is necessary to combine the predictions from multiple methods for the validation of the predictions.
